items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my son, who is a great record producer—he produced Janet Jackson and Dr. Dre

ctx.x: Could you tell me why so few recordings of your music are commercially available at this point?
Well, my son, who is a great record producer—he produced Janet Jackson and Dr. Dre and people like that…
Who was this and what did he say?
